blocks.label: Neutral Payoff
blocks.instructions:
Block 1: Neutral PayoffIdentify each vessel. Points are equal for both correct responses.
  • Correct: +10 pts either vessel
  • Wrong: -10 pts either vessel
  • Try to maximize your score

blocks.label: Asymmetric Payoff
blocks.instructions:
Block 2: Asymmetric PayoffSame task — but the payoffs have changed.
  • Correct Shchuka-B: +20 pts
  • Correct Kilo-877: +5 pts
  • Wrong: -10 pts either vessel
  • Adjust your strategy accordingly

blocks.label: Rare Signal
blocks.instructions:
Block 3: Rare SignalShchuka-B now appears on only 20% of trials.
  • Correct Shchuka-B: +30 pts
  • Correct Kilo-877: +5 pts
  • Wrong: -10 pts
  • Is it worth changing your strategy?
